title: Thanksgiving Math Escape Room 3rd Grade, Multiplication Division Fractions Elapsed Time Game, Printable Classroom Activity, Answer Key
description:
Thanksgiving math your 3rd graders will beg to finish. The pies for the Harvest Feast are locked in the Great Pie Vault, and only five correct code words open it. Print it, read the story, and your class practices a whole week of grade 3 skills in one fun period.

WHAT'S INSIDE (13 printable pages, PDF)
- Teacher guide with steps, timing and the standards for each lock
- Story page to launch the game
- Lock 1, The Pantry Door: multiply and divide within 100 (3.OA.C.7)
- Lock 2, The Cranberry Crate: two-step word problems (3.OA.D.8)
- Lock 3, The Recipe Box: rounding, adding and subtracting within 1,000 (3.NBT.A.1, 3.NBT.A.2)
- Lock 4, The Oven Timer: time to the minute and elapsed time (3.MD.A.1)
- Lock 5, The Pie Table: understanding fractions (3.NF.A.1, 3.NF.A.3)
- Student recording sheet and the final vault page
- Full answer key with every code word
- Escape Expert certificate

21 problems in all. Every answer in the key was checked twice before this listing went live.

HOW IT WORKS
Students solve each problem, find the letter next to their answer, and write the letters in the lock's boxes to spell a code word. You check each code word with the key. The first letters of the five code words open the vault. Works for the whole class, small groups, math centers, early finishers or a homeschool afternoon. Takes about 45 to 60 minutes.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Grade 3. Strong 2nd graders and 4th graders reviewing can play too.
- Full colour, US Letter size, prints on any home or school printer.
- Digital download: nothing will be shipped. After purchase, download the PDF from your Etsy Purchases page.

LICENSE
Personal and single-classroom use only: one teacher, one classroom (or one homeschool family). Please do not share the file, post it online or resell it.
